title: No Personality?
paragraphs: “That’s the one Motoyasu kept sketching whenever he had free time, right? Ren should’ve seen her too.”
“Ah… the one Motoyasu is always drawing. If I remember right, her base color was white with cherry blossom-colored patterns… and blue eyes.”
“That’s her Filolial form. She looks different when she’s an angel.”
“I know. She had the appearance of a young girl with blonde hair and blue eyes, right? I’ve heard it so many times I’m sick of it.”

I’m grateful that everyone understands so well. Yes, that’s right. Filo-tan has the appearance of an angel who embodies the beauty of this world. And at the same time, she’s an angel with an innocent heart… truly wonderful.
“But that’s all the hints we have. We only know her adult form.”
“It’s a looping world, after all. There’s even a chance she’s already someone else’s possession by now.”
“I’m aware of that. But even so, I must find her.”
Father and the others let out deep sighs.
“Well, let’s just think of this as Motoyasu’s driving force. I think we owe him enough to help out.”
“That’s true… No matter the outcome, it doesn’t seem like we’ll lose anything.”
“So, Motoyasu, do you have any other clues or have you already tried something else?”
“Yes. This is Filo-tan in her regular Filolial form.”

I showed them the sketch of how Filo-tan looked when I first met her. Ah, such nostalgia. It was back when I was chasing that pig’s tail and met Father and Filo-tan pulling the cart. For some reason, I got carried away, mocked Filo-tan, and got kicked away. Just remembering it makes me feel like I could fly.
“Even though you bought up everything, you still didn’t find her, right?”
“Exactly. I didn’t find Filo-tan.”
“Hmm… then maybe she went somewhere else?”
“So last time, Father was considerate enough to use a trick to filter out only the Filolial eggs in the monster merchant’s lottery, but even then, she wasn’t there.”
“Your explanation is terrible, but I guess that means you’ve already searched everywhere that seemed likely? Probably checked every possible place given the timing?”

I nodded. If I focus too much on finding Filo-tan, Father gets killed, and if I take my eyes off Ren and Itsuki, they go berserk. That’s why in this loop, I’ve been keeping an eye on Ren and Itsuki just as Father advised.
“This really is a difficult problem. Not knowing whose possession she’s in is the biggest issue.”
“Besides, this loop is drastically different from the first world, isn’t it?”
“Yes. I never imagined Melromarc would end up in such a state.”
Ren and Itsuki pointed at me.
“That’s the issue. With all this chaos going on, where’s the guarantee that the egg of that Filo is still safe?”
My heart pounded hard.

W-what did you just say!? Are you suggesting that Filo-tan’s egg might have been broken amidst all that chaos? Come to think of it, Father mentioned this in the previous loop. He said that finding Filo-tan’s egg amidst all that commotion would be an almost impossible task.
“Even so, I will not give up!”
“Come on, let’s try to be understanding of Motoyasu’s feelings. It might be a difficult problem, but still.”
“But… trying to find something that might not even exist is impossible, isn’t it?”

“No, no. There’s also the possibility that Filo is a special case—maybe if you raise a Filolial egg in a specific way, she’ll hatch. After all, this world feels a lot like a game. Let’s have a little hope.”
“That’s optimistic. But I doubt Motoyasu is going to give up…”
“If he does give up, that’s probably when he decides to reset the loop and kills us, right? I’m sure he wouldn’t lay a hand on Naofumi, but can I and Ren expect any mercy?”
“That’s ridiculous…”
“Come on, this is Kitamura we’re talking about.”
Hearing Itsuki and Éclair’s words, Ren straightened his posture as if he was getting serious.
Me? Kill Ren and Itsuki? I can’t imagine that happening.
“If I remember correctly, according to the queen I met before, most of the merchants sensed Melromarc’s unrest and fled early, so the goods themselves should be relatively safe.”
“I hope that’s true…”
Father turned his gaze toward me.
“Does that Filo kid have any other distinguishing features or information? Was she sick or different in any way from other Filolials?”

“Filo-tan had a much more innocent personality compared to other kids. And she was a bit of a glutton who loved Father’s cooking. On the other hand, she used to say that my cooking wasn’t very tasty.”
“That’s exactly how all the Filolials who’ve eaten Naofumi’s food behave.”
“Her personality isn’t something you can tell by looks, and that’s not much of a clue.”
How rude. Sure, there were countless Filolials who adored Father’s cooking, but none of them loved his cooking as much as Filo-tan did.
“She spoke in a way that was slightly childish, matching her appearance. As for her scent, she smelled quite similar to Sakura-chan.”

“Okay, so if we sum up the characteristics: slightly childish, innocent personality, white color with cherry blossom patterns, blonde hair and blue eyes in her angel form. Everything else is pretty much common among Filolials. And her scent is similar to Sakura-chan’s.”
“Doesn’t that make her pretty generic?”
What did you say? Is that fool Itsuki picking a fight with Filo-tan?
I’ll gladly take that fight!
“No, that’s not it! Filo-tan is an angel!”
“Motoyasu, if you’re not going to explain, just stay quiet.”
“Alright, alright. Let’s change the question. There’s a breed called Filolial, right? What breed is that Filo kid?”
“She’s a Filolial Queen, I say.”
“That’s the most common type… Iwatani-dono.”
“Hmm… alright. Anything else?”
“She was engaged to her fiancé.”
“With Melty-chan? Ah, I guess the me from the first world pushed Motoyasu onto her to get rid of him, huh? …Right now, the one who’s closest to Melty-chan is Sakura-chan, right?”
Father, who was summarizing everything in his notes, looked at me. Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan.
“So please tell Sakura-chan. If she gets too close to her fiancé, Filo-tan will be heartbroken.”
“Is that Filo kid similar to Sakura-chan?”
“She’s not as laid-back as Sakura-chan.”
“Hmm…”
Father was twirling his pen through his hair, looking deep in thought. Even Father seems to find this a difficult problem.
“In our minds, we keep thinking of Sakura-chan. But in all the loops so far, Motoyasu hasn’t been able to meet this Filo kid. Even after carefully timing it in Melromarc, he couldn’t find her.”
“Maybe we should ask the queen to search the entire country for Filolials?”

“That might be the best option. Since we know she’s a white Filolial with cherry blossom patterns and a female, with that many details, even if someone’s raising her after hatching, we should be able to find her. Considering how chaotic the previous loops were, it’s possible there just wasn’t enough time.”
“Even so, I want to do everything I can.”
“Then, since her scent is similar to Sakura-chan’s… if we’re talking about body scent, maybe they’re related?”
“Ah, I see. Motoyasu, where did you purchase Sakura and Yuki?”
“From a ranch not far after leaving Melromarc.”

Since I’ve registered it with the portal, I can go to that ranch anytime. I’ve always been in the care of that Filolial farmer. I bought Yuki-chan and the others from there because I can easily trace their lineage.
“So, if Filo might be related to Sakura-chan, wouldn’t it be a good idea to buy out the Filolials when you go to that place called Cal Mira Island to raise them? What do you think, Motoyasu?”
“Understood!”

Now that I think about it, I once told that Filolial farmer that I would show them how the Filolials had grown, but I’ve never actually done that. This is a perfect opportunity. I’ll proudly show off the noble and elegant figure of Yuki-chan, my top recommendation.
“Then, once Yuki-chan and the others return from their walk, we’ll set off.”
“Make sure to gather enough money.”
“Of course! I’ll take a huge cut of the reward from our mission! Enough to empty the castle’s treasury!”
“Um… just take what you can carry.”
Father gave me a warning, but now that I have a goal in sight, nothing can stop me! And so, we decided to head to the Filolial ranch after a long time.
Chapter 703 – Ranch
We have arrived at the ranch area a little distance from Melromarc.
“This is where Sakura-chan and the others were born… I guess that’s how it would be?”
Father murmured while looking around.
Indeed. It’s a peaceful and pleasant ranch.
“Yeah… it really feels like a calm pasture.”
“It’s like the typical scenery you’d imagine when you think of a ranch.”
I visit this place within a few days in every loop to purchase Yuki-chan and the others.
“I always think this, but they put a lot of effort into maintaining bloodlines here.”
“Hmm… yeah, I can see that. How should I put it… even the regular Filolials here seem to have a slight sheen to their feathers.”
“There’s one with strangely thin legs. It looks like it’d break if I tried to ride it.”
“That one is not meant for riding. If you try, it might cause problems with its legs.”
I explained to Ren about the Filolial he was pointing at. This is exactly the kind of situation where my knowledge shines.
“That’s likely a thoroughbred of the Fidarmeo breed, which is specialized solely for running. It’s one of the fastest selected from that type.”
“Wow, there’s such complex breeding involved, huh… I’ve played horse-raising games before, so I kind of get it…”
“Is it that complicated?”
“Yeah… there’s a similar game with Ch○cobos, but if you don’t pay close attention to the bloodlines, you can’t win against other players. To explain it simply to Ren—”
Father started drawing something resembling a complex family tree on the ground.
Indeed. The Filolials here are definitely raised with more complex bloodline management than what Father was sketching.

“Inbreeding… which is breeding close relatives, and outbreeding, which is crossing different lineages, are intricately combined. It involves matching compatible bloodlines and all sorts of complex factors. Honestly, if you were to simulate it seriously, it’d take all day.”
“I-I see… Naofumi, you know a lot about this.”

“Well, it’s just something I picked up from games. I wasn’t that obsessed with it, though. But if these factors apply to Filolials too, there are probably ones bred solely to shave off seconds in speed.”
“Nano… Filolials are doing something pretty complicated.”
“Guuaaaa!”
The moment my rival spoke, the Filolials in the ranch started stirring. As expected, they see the rival as a nuisance.
“Uh… Gaelion-chan, this is Filolial territory, and having a dragon around will cause trouble for the ranchers.”
“Eh… Gaelion can’t stay?”
The assistant was stating the obvious.
“Nano, Gaelion will win the territorial dispute with the Filolials.”
“I’m telling you it’ll cause trouble. If things get noisy, I won’t be able to calm Motoyasu…”
Exactly. If they keep disturbing the Filolials, I’ll dismantle them once. They won’t die anyway. I gave them a glare.
“Shall we teleport with the portal?”
“I want to know the enemy, nano. I know almost everything about Filolials, but there might still be things I don’t know, nano.”
“Hmm… okay then, Sakura-chan.”
“What is it?”
“It might be unpleasant, but could you hold Gaelion-chan and try not to stand out?”
“Ehh… okay.”
Father asked something unreasonable of Sakura-chan. The gentle Sakura-chan reluctantly took her Filolial form and spread her wings forward.
“Gaelion-chan, shrink down as much as possible.”
“Ugh… okay, nano. Being hugged by a Filolial is torture, but it’s for Naofumi.”
The rival shrank down and was held by Sakura-chan, hiding under her feathers. Quite an impressive position, I must say. The rival’s head was peeking out just a little from Sakura-chan’s chest.
What do they mean by “for Father”? Father ignored the rival’s words.
“Well, that should be enough… to hide him to some extent.”
With the rival’s intimidating presence subdued, the Filolials in the ranch quieted down. However, this is merely a fleeting peace. If given the chance, I’ll teleport the rival away with the portal.
“For now, the rancher here… what are we going to do?”
“Are we asking about the Filolials that Motoyasu likes? Or are we buying out a new batch of Filolials?”
“Considering Motoyasu’s objective, probably both? Motoyasu, you’re looking forward to this, right?”
“Of course!”
With a light step, I went to meet the rancher I always buy Yuki-chan and the others from. I cheerfully knocked on the door of the building that serves as the office.
“The one who keeps buying from you but always forgets to show the grown-up Filolials, Kitamura Motoyasu, has come to visit!”
“Is that really how you should introduce yourself?”
Father made a comment. Ren and Itsuki also somehow agreed with him. …But there’s no response.
“They’re probably taking care of the Filolials in one of the nearby barns.”
“It must feel strange for them to be understood so well despite hardly ever meeting.”
“Are we really the ones to say that? Motoyasu understands almost everything about our actions.”
“When you look at Motoyasu that way, it does give a different impression.”
With a skip in my step, I headed toward the building where the Filolial rancher was likely to be.
“There are so many Filolials here, aren’t there?”

Sensing Yuki-chan and the others, the Filolials seemed to be watching with slight tension. Perhaps noticing this, the Filolial rancher emerged from the barn and looked at us. They noticed me waving from the front and seemed to relax their guard a little.
“Oh, it’s you.”
“Oh, do you remember me?”
“How could I possibly forget someone as unique as you?”
“Well…”
“Yeah… I think forgetting Motoyasu would be a pretty tall order.”
The Filolial rancher approached us, leading a Filolial.
Were they in the middle of some work? Then, they casually glanced at Sakura-chan in her Filolial form.
What do you think?
“So? It’s been a while, but did you finally come to show me the Filolials? Where are they?”
Huh? Does Sakura-chan not count as a Filolial? No, their gaze seems somewhat fixated on Sakura-chan. Of course, of course. Anyone who understands would recognize her.
“As I mentioned before, she has grown into a legendary Filolial and is right here before you!”
I stepped behind Yuki-chan and Kou, presenting them to the rancher.
Why are they only looking at Sakura-chan?
“What are you talking about? Are you joking? Well, I can see that pinkish Filolial with unusually thick feathers, but…”
The Filolial rancher looked at Yuki-chan and Kou, furrowing their brow in displeasure. They seemed to notice the feathers on Kou’s back, but their expression didn’t change much.
“These feathers… They’re mimicking a Filolial quite well… crafted with remarkable precision… but that’s all!”
What did you say!? Are you saying you can’t immediately recognize the appearance of a Filolial who has become an angel? And you still call yourself a Filolial rancher?
“Motoyasu, they won’t understand if you don’t explain it properly.”
“Why is that?”
“Ah, sorry. He’s absolutely terrible at explaining things.”
“Yeah, I figured as much. But I thought I could at least understand his passion—”
The Filolial rancher looked at me with what felt like a condescending gaze.
“This is outrageous! How can you not recognize it at a glance!?”
A Filolial rancher should be able to tell at a glance! Otherwise, they’re not fit to be called a rancher!
“Motoyasu, just explain it properly!”
“Ugh… I know it’s hard to believe, and even if they see it with their own eyes, it takes time to accept…”
“Yuki-chan, if you don’t want Motoyasu’s reputation to drop any further in their eyes, seeing is believing. Show them your Filolial form.”
“Understood!”

*Poof!* Yuki-chan transformed into her Filolial Queen form right in front of the rancher. I folded my arms and looked down on the rancher with disdain. To think they couldn’t recognize a Filolial no matter what form they take…
I’m too astonished to even speak.
